flamekeeper.name: Flamekeeper
flamekeeper.description: Unit and allies are unaffected by Underworld Flames and take half damage from attacks while in Underworld Flames.

bestial-impulse.name: Bestial Impulse

royal-resolve.name: Royal Resolve

unstoppable-force.name: Unstoppable Force
unstoppable-force.description: Multiplies damage by 3 when attacking obstacles.

direct-hit.name: Direct Hit

tactician-s-wit.name: Tactician’s Wit

tactician-s-insight-plus.name: Tactician’s Insight+
tactician-s-insight-plus.description: After combat, If unit attacked first, inflicts Avo-10 on foe throughout their next combat.

dark-secrets-plus.name: Dark Secrets+

additional-intel-plus.name: Additional Intel+

retaliatory-blow-plus.name: Retaliatory Blow+
retaliatory-blow-plus.description: If foe attacks first, multiples damage by 1.3 when attacking. Trigger % = 10.

correct-for-drift-plus.name: Correct for Drift+

brawn.name: Brawn

throwing-arm-plus.name: Throwing Arm+

power-arts.name: Power Arts

all-out-attack-plus.name: All-Out Attack+

goddess-s-favor.name: Goddess’s Favor

wind-s-caprice-plus.name: Wind’s Caprice+
wind-s-caprice-plus.description: Grants one of Avo+1, Avo+5, Avo+20, or Avo+30 during combat.

patch-up.name: Patch Up

veteran-s-mettle.name: Veteran’s Mettle
veteran-s-mettle.description: Grants Hit+10 during combat against an adjacent foe.

redblade-s-will.name: Redblade’s Will

redblade-s-will-plus.name: Redblade’s Will+

racing-attack.name: Racing Attack
racing-attack.description: If unit attacks first, grants Avo+15 during combat.

accelerate.description: After defeating a foe, grants Spd+1 until the end of the map. (Max +10)

accelerate-plus.description: After defeating a foe, grants Spd+2 until the end of the map. (Max +10)

competitive-zeal.name: Competitive Zeal
competitive-zeal.description: When equipped with magic, grants Crit +10.

ardent-nosferatu.name: Ardent Nosferatu

ardent-nosferatu-plus.name: Ardent Nosferatu+

cannoning-flair.name: Cannoning Flair

continuum-plus.name: Continuum+

dramatic-effect-plus.name: Dramatic Effect+

perception-plus.name: Perception+

gift-of-faith-plus.name: Gift of Faith+

steadfast.name: Steadfast

halt-advance-plus.name: Halt Advance+

chariot-stagger-plus.name: Chariot Stagger+
